blurb: Species recorded near the park, linked by recorded feeding.

tip.title: Remove Poison Ivy
tip.text: Set Poison Ivy to -100% and see which species are affected.

notes: Built automatically, not checked by a person. The species are the most often recorded in GBIF within about 1.5 km of the park location (location from PAD-US boundary). Feeding links are only those with a GloBI record: for the species itself, its genus or, for plants and insects, its family. Library: automatic.
